svg.title: Tribe Trust Framework — uniform card grid
svg.desc: Three stacked sections: the core problem, five psychological friction points, and five system design responses, all in uniform cards.

g.text: People don't type what they actually need. The barrier is psychological, not linguistic.

svg.text: 5 friction points — what the person feels before typing

g.text: What will it think of me?
Will it use this against me?

svg.text: 5 design responses — how the system earns trust

g.text: Honest intent typed → NLP reads context → person finds what they actually needed

svg.text: core — the central design problem and its response
the search box is not a language problem — it is a psychological safety problem
tribe is designed for the moment before the query, not the moment it arrives
